Kjaere Chloé Petit, 

Vi har gleden av a tilby deg stillingen som Markedsanalytiker i avdeling Produksjon.

|**Fodselsdato:**|03.03.2000|
|---|---|
|**Tiltredelse:**|10.06.2026|
|**Ansettelsesform:**|Fast stilling|
|**Stillingsprosent:**|100.0%|

Vilkar: Ansettelsesforholdet reguleres av arbeidsmiljoloven og bedriftens personalhandbok. Det gjelder en provetid pa 6 maneder med 14 dagers gjensidig oppsigelsesfrist. Etter provetiden er oppsigelsesfristen 3 maneder. Ferie og feriepenger folger ferieloven.

payload.goal: Onboard the new employee from the attached offer letter: create employee, create/assign department, set employment details, annual salary, employment percentage, and standard working hours.
success_checks: Employee record exists for Chloé Petit with date of birth 2000-03-03.
Department 'Produksjon' exists and the employee is assigned to it.
Employment start date is set to 2026-06-10.
Employment type is set to permanent/full-time equivalent as stated.
Annual salary is set to 600000 NOK.
Standard working time is set to 7.5 hours per day.
risk_notes: Sandbox is empty; department must be created before assignment if it does not exist.
Offer letter does not include email, phone, address, employee number, bank account, tax card, or national ID; some employee creation flows may require additional fields.
'Fast stilling' is interpreted as permanent employment; exact enum/value may vary by API.
Working hours are stated per day only; if API requires weekly hours, conversion may be needed.
Salary currency is implied as NOK from 'kr' but not explicitly labeled.
ordered_steps: Create employee record for Chloé Petit via employee endpoint with dateOfBirth=2000-03-03.
Update employee/employment details: job title 'Markedsanalytiker', start date 2026-06-10, employment type permanent, employment percentage 100.0.
Configure salary/payroll settings with annual salary 600000 NOK.
Configure standard working hours to 7.5 hours per day.
Verify employee, department assignment, salary, and working hours persisted correctly.

planned_endpoints.summary: Find employees corresponding with sent data.

rules: ALWAYS search first: GET /employee?email=<email> — the sandbox often has pre-existing employees. Reuse if found.
Only POST /employee if GET returns 0 results.
When POSTing, ALWAYS include department={"id": dept_id}. Create department first if needed.
userType should be 'STANDARD' unless admin is explicitly requested.
